title: mentha longifolia var. ligustrina
intro: Mentha longifolia var. ligustrina, commonly known as Horn Mint, is a variety of the Mentha longifolia plant, a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region and parts of Europe. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Horn Mint include its ability to relieve digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and combat respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Horn Mint include menthone, isomenthone, and menthol, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
